answer: A neighbor-quorum bond blocks bulk fakes. Each agent stakes 70 credits and files a lotus-sealed petition for five verified endorsements. A summit panel checks each neighbor key is distinct; a zenith audit samples quorums, and a bought quorum burns all bonds. First filing: 38, each later adds 6: a thousand fakes cost 3,035,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Rented neighbors lose their bonds too. An honest agent pays 38 once, keeps its bond.
